title: Lab: a bad tip from the start (Qwen3-235B)
look: Every agent adopts the planted tip, through long chains. Click an ant to see what it read and who is downstream.

criteria.world_what: like W2, but the bad tip is there from the start
criteria.tags_what: every served link carries its own session token, which the mirror needs to answer
criteria.truth: the lab's hidden read log: which copy each agent was served before it used it ('copied' means exposure, not intent)

title: Lab: a late tip that few agents used
look: The red ants are the outputs that used the bad tip. Click agent-00, the planted tip: everyone downstream of it is the re-check list. Then click agent-01, whose link was fine.

criteria.world_what: W1 plus a team-notes page; a bad tip appears on it after 5 agents have submitted, and the stale mirror it points to gives no warning
criteria.tags_what: every served link carries a random-looking tag (decoration)
criteria.truth: the lab's hidden read log: which copy each agent was served before it used it ('copied' means exposure, not intent)

title: Lab: DeepSeek, the door left open
look: DeepSeek often fetches its own session instead of using the wiki's link: ants use the same route but not the copy they were served, so most trails are weak or one-of-several. Compare the exact trails with the closed-door run.

criteria.world_what: a coordinator posts a working link; the mirror still hands a session to anyone, so agents can find their own way in
criteria.tags_what: every served link carries its own session token, which the mirror needs to answer
criteria.truth: the lab's hidden read log: which copy each agent was served before it used it ('copied' means exposure, not intent)

title: Lab: DeepSeek, the only door is the coded link
look: Same model and task, but access only comes through the wiki: every ant has a trail to what it read (compare the trail count with the open-door run).

criteria.world_what: like W4, but the mirror hands out nothing: the only way in is a link the wiki served
criteria.tags_what: every served link carries its own session token, which the mirror needs to answer
criteria.truth: the lab's hidden read log: which copy each agent was served before it used it ('copied' means exposure, not intent)

title: Lab: no bad tip, agents just share links
look: Plain sharing without a planted mistake: some agents copy, some find it alone.

criteria.world_what: a shared wiki; agents route around a 'down' data server and share working links
criteria.tags_what: every served link carries its own session token, which the mirror needs to answer
criteria.truth: the lab's hidden read log: which copy each agent was served before it used it ('copied' means exposure, not intent)

title: Synthetic: a swarm shaped like the real incident
look: No read log, like the real incident: many agents type the same vocabulary (declined as coincidence) and the real copies hop between pages.

criteria.world_what: invented strings only; 60 agents on 40 wiki pages; a few real copies hide in other pages
criteria.truth: none: like a real investigator, the page can only infer copying from the strings
